info.title: BRICX IQ API
info.description: Construction management: offline-first, multi-currency (money is minor units as strings), fully audited. Errors are application/problem+json in the ADR 0047 envelope.

503.description: A dependency is down: the same report with status error.
A dependency is down: the same report with status error.

default.description: Any error: an RFC 9457 problem body in the ADR 0047 envelope (status, code, key, traceId, issues).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key unique to this request from this user (a UUID): the same key replays the first answer for 24 h; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency.key_reused.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present, "true", when this answer is the replay of an earlier request under the same Idempotency-Key; absent on the first answer.
